title: Low lunge

steps.text: Start on your hands and knees on the mat.
steps.cue: Start on your hands and knees.

steps.text: Step one foot forward and place it flat, with the knee above the ankle.
steps.cue: Step one foot forward, knee over the ankle.

steps.text: Slide the other knee back until you feel a gentle stretch at the front of that hip.
steps.cue: Slide the other knee back. Gentle stretch.

steps.text: Rest your hands on your front thigh or on the mat and breathe slowly.
steps.cue: Hands on your thigh or the mat. Breathe slowly.

steps.text: Step back to hands and knees, then change sides.
steps.cue: Step back to hands and knees.
steps.say: Step back to hands and knees.

mistakes: Letting the front knee fall inward.
Sinking the hips further than feels comfortable.
regression: Take a shorter step and keep your hips higher.
stopIf: Come out if either knee hurts.

anatomy.why: Letting the hips sink forward lengthens the front of the back hip and thigh.

sources.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e: 11.6 Appendicular muscles of the pelvic girdle and lower limbs
